examples.english: Since the room is small, I use a folding bed and put it away during the day.

notes:
ベッド (from English "bed") is the standard term for Western-style beds with frames and mattresses. Japanese traditionally sleep on ⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧ (futon) on the floor.

Common types:
- ⟦シングルベッド→シングルベッド：noentry⟧ (single bed)
- ⟦ダブルベッド→ダブルベッド：noentry⟧ (double bed)
- ⟦{二段|にだん}ベッド→二段ベッド：noentry⟧ (bunk bed)
- ⟦ソファベッド→ソファベッド：noentry⟧ (sofa bed)
- ⟦{折|お}りたたみベッド→折りたたみベッド：noentry⟧ (folding bed)

Related terms:
- ⟦マットレス→マットレス：07098_mattoresu⟧ (mattress)
- ⟦ベッドフレーム→ベッドフレーム：noentry⟧ (bed frame)
- ⟦{枕|まくら}→枕：03898_makura⟧ (pillow)

Note: In hospitals, ベッド refers to a hospital bed, and ベッド⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ means "number of beds" (capacity).
